AuthorizationInvalidationConnection.description:
The connection-visible negotiated expectation. The authenticated
descriptor remains server-held; once startup has verified it, the client
receives the exact issuer id over the authenticated connection bootstrap.

authorization.description:
Closed initial client expectation. A clean subscription with no
pending projection must never invent epoch zero.

AuthorizationVersion.description:
The one durable authorization-stream witness. The incarnation closes reset
and restore ABA; the JS-safe epoch advances for ordinary authorization
events within that stream.

@ref LLP 0053#the-authorization-version — v1 has one global durable pair.

IssuerId.description: A boot identity is never reused, even when process-local counters restart.

IssuerRetirement.description:
Server-authenticated proof that every live scope issued by an older boot in
the same authorization incarnation is extinct. It cannot release retained
bytes by itself; a current fresh snapshot must still satisfy their witness.

description:
The `POST /connection/open` response: the (possibly adopted) connection id
and the bearer the caller must present on every connection-scoped call.

devIdentityCapabilityWitnessed.description:
Credential-free, dev-only observation of the capability check performed
for this exact open. `false` is intentionally distinct from absence so
stage-2 carrier witnesses fail if a relay or native client strips the
header even though the open itself remains compatibility-admitted.

@ref LLP 0262#d2-carriers-per-shipped-topology — topology witnesses
  consume server-recorded custody, never client-side header intent.

ephemeralAuthorityInstance.description:
Opaque authority-instance witness. Every negotiated ephemeral frame
repeats this value so clients can fence in-memory state across target
process replacement.

ephemeralAuthorityProtocol.description:
Echo present iff the client offered the known hosted-ephemeral
authority protocol. Absence never fails durable/local connection use.

ephemeralExpiryProtocol.description:
Echo present iff the connection lineage negotiated LLP 0107's
monotonic ephemeral-expiry conversion protocol.

hostedEphemeralAuthorityRequired.description:
Present and true only when this lineage was opened under a current
authenticated hosted single-instance admission. Such a lineage must
repeat protocol 1 on reopen and present its exact instance on every
governed HTTP request or WebSocket upgrade.

@ref LLP 0094#hosted-ephemeral-per-boundary-contract — absence is the
  legacy-local compatibility case; hosted authority is fail-closed.

wireVersion.description:
Bound-wire-version witness (LLP 0094 §0B.3): present on every open and
re-open response of an explicitly bound lineage, never on a legacy
(offerless-open) lineage. Echo present ⇔ explicitly bound.

@ref LLP 0094#0b3-the-wireversion-open-time-offer — the additive echo
  is the hosted arm's only runtime version witness (§0B.6).
